name: Levira Tartu data center
notes: Levira states it operates three data center locations, two in Tallinn and one in Tartu; AM.ee reported Levira opened the Tartu server room/data center, built by A-Kaabel, as its third data center and newest server room in Tartu. Capacity not disclosed in public sources reviewed.

name: Telia Company Valga
notes: Multiple data-center directory sources list an operational Telia/Telia Carrier Valga data center in Valga County; addresses vary between Raja 5 and Võru tänav 116a, so location details should be treated cautiously. Capacity not disclosed in sources reviewed.

name: Telia Company Karksi-Nuia Data Center
notes: Data center directory listings place Telia Company Karksi-Nuia at Pärnu maantee 6a, Karksi-Nuia, Viljandi maakond; Datacenters.com lists 3.0 MW total power. Public primary/operator source not found in this run.
